families.description: Every money movement is a ledger journal keyed by (tenant X, transactor_event, transactor_id). Shared/VA-source payouts post synchronously from payouts (initiated at create, processed/failed/reversed on FTS status); Direct-account payouts are statement-driven DA journals posted by the monolith (PS emitter deprecated); merchant balance is a materialised column updated in the same DB txn as the journal.
families.label: Ledger accounting (shared / VA-to-VA / FAV / Direct-account journals)

families.description: Razorpay-internal admin actions: manual status update (single + batch), manual_action, retry, bulk cancel, workflow retry, FTA bulk update, fee recovery, BAS source relink, and the ANY service/batch/{path} passthrough to the Batch service.
families.label: Admin / ops manual actions on payouts

families.description: Payout / bulk-payout approval: config (range/steps/roles) -> WFS Cadence graph -> N-of-M role-based approvals -> approve/reject callback into payouts or xperience. Three independent creator paths: monolith (single payout), payouts service (PS-owned payout), xperience (bulk payout).
families.label: Maker-checker approval workflow (payouts + bulk payouts)

families.description: 25 registered jobs, one process per PAYOUTS_WORKER_NAME, SQS driver with visibilityTimeout 120s / waitTimeout 30s; per-job MaxRetries 3-7 and Timeout 30-1800s; a generic_processing catch-all keyed by processType. 15 of the 25 run in the twin.
families.label: Async worker fabric (SQS jobs)

families.description: x-balances polls bank balances per channel via Mozart (creds from banking-accounts), overwrites balance.balance/last_fetched_at, dual-writes to monolith BASD and (DCS-gated) publishes BalanceRefreshEvent; payouts selects the source account via ListAccounts (MAR), gates Direct dispatch on x-balances balance minus Redis in-flight reservations, and releases awaiting holds when last_fetched_at passes dispatched_at+lag.
families.label: Direct-account balance refresh, MAR and in-flight reservations

families.description: PS->FTS vs PS->monolith->FTS create, FTS->PS vs relay vs Kafka status, per-bank/mode selection, bank result classification.
families.label: Bank and channel routing

families.description: channel_information_status/fail_fast/trigger_status feed routingv2 (mode_selection, route_selection, priority_route, multi_account_routing_rules) called by PS; alertmanager -> /v1/channel_health_events; downtimeV2 notifies PS /v1/notify/downtime and /v1/notify/health/update.
families.label: Bank/channel health, downtime, routing & mode selection

families.description: CFA owns contact/fund-account CRUD with hash-based dedup and structural validation only; MongoDB is the write store with API-DB read fallback and 30s-delayed SQS dual-write; real verification (penny-drop) is ValidX's, and CFA has no verified/unverified gate.
families.label: Contacts and fund accounts (beneficiaries)

families.description: /v1/account, /v1/account/register -> register_beneficiary/verify_beneficiary (shared + icici/axis/batch queues) -> Mozart beneficiary_register/verify -> beneficiary_status; fire_bene_status_webhook.
families.label: Beneficiary (fund account) registration/verification with banks

families.description: Two coexisting bulk pipelines. (1) Classic: dashboard -> monolith batch proxy -> Batch service -> POST payouts/bulk on the monolith (proxyAuth as batch) -> PS POST /v1/payouts/bulk. (2) xperience BFF: dashboard -> monolith XperienceController -> xperience -> Batch (validate then process) with its own maker-checker workflow against WFS.
families.label: Bulk payouts (file upload -> batch -> per-row payout create / bulk approve)

families.description: vendor-payments TDS accrual -> tag-back -> Pay -> shared ingress -> real payouts -> SourceUpdater callback
families.label: Cross-domain Source-to-Pay TDS remittance (M7)

families.description: dashboard.razorpay.com / x.razorpay.com -> /merchant/api/{mode}/* -> Kong api-dashboard-merchant (basic-auth-x anonymous consumer, identification-only passport, authz-enforcer ENFORCED) -> monolith proxyAuth (Basic merchant-id:internal-app-secret) with X-Dashboard-* headers -> UserAccess role check -> OTP for create/approve.
families.label: Merchant dashboard (X) ingress: cookie + CSRF + passport + OTP/2FA

families.description: Forward dual-write of payout entities into the API monolith DB (async_dual_write, and a direct-push variant onto the monolith's own queue), reverse dual-write (/v1/cron/reverse_dual_write), a consistency checker fanning out data_consistency_checker/-event jobs, payouts_temp / fund_transfer_attempts_temp shadow tables and a TiDB consistency cron.
families.label: Dual-write and data-consistency checking

families.description: fund_account_payout_direct processor: merchant's own bank current account (RBL/ICICI/Axis...). Adds banking_accounts credential lookup, in-flight balance reservation, partner-bank downtime holds and direct-account ledger events (da_ext_debit / da_payout_processed).
families.label: Direct (current-account) payouts

families.description: Reversal rows (reversals table) + payout_status_details; cancel_payout for queued|scheduled|on_hold; payout_create_failure_handling / payout_update_failure_handling workers compensate half-written creates and status updates; free-payout/credit unwind on failure.
families.label: Failure, reversal and cancellation

families.description: Every payouts behaviour toggle: DCS config objects under rzp/x/merchant/payouts/* (protobuf-typed, per-merchant, fieldmask-redacted, BigCache 15s) and Splitz experiments resolved per merchant id. Both fail OFF: a DCS fetch error substitutes an empty FeatureMap, and Splitz GetVariantOrDefault returns variant 'default' with result 'off'.
families.label: Feature flags and experiments (DCS + Splitz)

families.description: GET /v1/payouts[/:id], fetch_multiple (public and cron variants), status_details, analytics, _meta/summary and the Elasticsearch-backed index. Read path is experiment-heavy: orchestrator fetch, API-DB fallback, microservice fetch.
families.label: Payout fetch / list / status-details / search

families.description: retry_transfer -> retry_transfer_preprocessor (XAS statement check for debit/credit) -> retry_preprocessor_status_update; stuck_payouts cron (canary only); manual_action queue (ma::); ART /v1/attempts actions -> process_attempt_update; /v1/manual_queries/update.
families.label: Retry, retry-preprocessor (XAS), stuck-payouts, manual/ART repair

families.description: fire_transfer_status_webhook picks destination: Kafka (splitz fire_status_update_kafka) > PS direct transfer_status_webhook (create_transfer_meta_rollout AND transfer_meta.origin_service=payouts) > legacy monolith /v1/update_fts_fund_transfer (which relays PATCH update_payouts_with_fts + POST update_payouts_details_with_fts). 3 retries x 200s, no DLQ. Separate retry_transfer_source_update task POSTs PS /v1/payouts/retry/source_update.
families.label: FTS -> Payouts status propagation (HTTP webhook / monolith relay / Kafka / source-update)

families.description: The api monolith owns the merchant-facing FAV entity; ValidX executes the actual verification (pennydrop/penniless/paisadrop/upi_intent) across FTS, Citi (via Mozart), the monolith and Slice, then reports back either by Stork (fund_account.validation.completed/failed, DCS Stork.enable_stork) or by POSTing /v1/fund_accounts/validations_internal/webhook, plus an SQS dual-write. Payouts itself has NO synchronous FAV gate and never calls ValidX -- its own FAV module calls the monolith at /fund_accounts/validations_internal/pennydrop.
families.label: Fund-account validation (FAV / penny testing)

families.description: Admin/cron sets a per-merchant balance config (/v1/fund-management-payout/balance-config/...); /v1/cron/fund_management_payouts/check dispatches one fund_management_payout_check job per merchant; when a top-up is required a fund_management_payout_initiate job creates the FMP payout. Config lives in the DCS ApiInterface fmp_config field.
families.label: Fund management payouts (FMP)

families.description: POST /v1/transfer (PS or monolith) -> transfers/attempts rows -> initiate_transfer (bank-scoped queue) -> Mozart transfer_init -> check_transfer_status polling with per-bank backoff -> terminal state. Twin: RBL pool/direct IMPS+NEFT only, Mozart replaced by mozart-sim.
journeys_existing: ENV2_COMPOSE/verifier/BANK_SCENARIOS.md: hold, delayed_success, ambiguous_with_utr, ambiguous_without_utr, duplicate, timeout
families.label: Fund transfer execution (FTS transfer -> attempt -> Mozart -> bank)

families.description: IdempotencyKey middleware keyed on X-Payout-Idempotency (+ X-Payout-Actor-Id / -Actor-Type headers) with a request hash in idempotency_keys; exclusions in idempotency_key_exclusions (GET /v1/idempotency-keys/check-excluded); duplicate_prevention_config + shield/duplicate evaluate; payout_attempts records retries; POST /v1/payouts/retry re-drives failed payouts.
families.label: Idempotency keys, duplicate prevention and retries

families.description: Every internal-app credential in config/applications.php and the per-app route allow-list Route::$internalApps that constrains it, plus the reciprocal inbound credentials each downstream service accepts (workflows basic auth, batch basic auth, xperience InternalAuth, PS cred.API/cred.Workflow).
families.label: Service-to-service internal routes and their credentials

families.description: POST /v1/merchant_onboarding (banking-accounts or FastCron creds) creates the PS-side merchant record; merchant_configurations rows are written by the merchant-configuration admin group and the /v1/cron/merchant_configuration endpoints; DCS objects hold the feature side.
families.label: Merchant onboarding and per-merchant configuration

families.description: POST /fts/<gateway>/<version>/<action>; envelope {data,next,error,success,mozart_id,external_trace_id}; -mock mode replays app/testdata fixtures keyed by methodScenarioField. Twin: mozart-sim (RBL v1 grounded, 6 scenarios) — real Mozart unbuildable.
families.label: Mozart gateway (namespace fts): 8 FTS operations across 15 gateways / 26 gateway-versions

families.description: /v1/cron/payouts_sla_breach_monitor queries TiDB for IMPS/UPI/NEFT SLA breaches; a stuck-payouts monitor and runtime log-sampling controls (/v1/cron/log_sampling) sit alongside it.
families.label: SLA breach monitoring, stuck payouts and log sampling

families.description: HoldPayoutIfBeneBankDown parks a payout in on_hold when the bene bank is down; a separate partner-bank-downtime path (splitz partner_bank_on_hold_payouts_experiment) uses the partner_bank_hold_payouts worker and /v1/cron/process_queued_payouts. Merchant SLAs are set via POST /v1/merchant/update_on_hold_slas; FTS notifies downtime on /v1/notify/downtime.
families.label: On-hold payouts (beneficiary bank + partner bank downtime)

families.description: payout-links creates a payout through the api monolith's /v1/payouts_internal with an X-Payout-Idempotency header and learns the outcome from the monolith's twirp UpdatePayoutLinkStatus push, mapping payout status onto 8 payout-link statuses and emitting payout_link.* merchant webhooks through Stork.
families.label: Payout links

families.description: Fee resolution on payout create and the free-payout counter that zeroes it. Default path: a Redis cache pre-populated by the monolith, falling back to a live POST /payouts_service/fetch_pricing_info; only when the charge_collections_call experiment is on does the ccSdk (Charge Collections + Governor rule chains) resolve the fee instead. free_payout fee_type always uses the monolith call. The free-payout counter lives in PS's own counters table and is mirrored to the monolith's counters table (monthly IST reset, row-locked).
families.label: Payout pricing (fees/tax) and the free-payout allowance

families.description: api.razorpay.com/v1/payouts: Kong consumer-authentication (basic-auth-x merchant key/secret) -> upstream-jwt mints an authenticated passport (exp+300s) -> monolith privateAuth (KeyAuthCreds) or, in devstack only, upstream-override diverts the cohort straight to the payouts service.
families.label: Public API ingress: merchant key basic auth -> passport -> privateAuth

families.description: queue_if_low_balance=true parks the payout in queued; the queueing strategy uses the DCS balance buffer fields; release happens on x-balances balance-refresh events, on balance_update_event, or via the /v1/cron/process_queued_low_balance_payouts cron -> queued_payout worker. The in-flight reservation store (Redis) is the fail-closed dispatch gate.
families.label: Queued payouts (low balance)

families.description: scheduled_at in the future -> state scheduled; GET /v1/payouts/schedule/timeslots exposes slots; /v1/cron/process_scheduled_payouts (and internal /v1/payouts/scheduled/process) dispatch one schedule_payout job per due payout.

families.description: merchant, dashboard, internal-application and administrator paths through the shared ingress into the real Payouts service
families.label: Shared API-monolith ingress (M7)

families.description: fund_account_payout_shared / fund_account_payout_sub_balance processors: merchant sits on a shared RazorpayX pool balance. Create -> pricing -> credits -> ledger/transaction -> FTS -> status. Entry via POST /v1/payouts (monolith proxy) or POST /v2/payouts.
families.label: Shared (pool) account payouts

families.description: the vendor-payments / vendor-experience / accounting-integrations domain as mapped by DOMAIN_REPLICAS/source_to_pay
families.label: Source-to-Pay TDS domain (namespaced)

families.description: payout_sources + source_request_id_mapping record which product created the payout; the payout_source_updater worker notifies the source on every status change, either by the legacy path or by SNS fan-out to per-source topics (splitz source_updater_sns_experiment). FTS also re-drives it through POST /v1/payouts/retry/source_update.
families.label: Payout source notification (payout_links / vendor_payments / xpayroll / ...)

families.description: Bank current-account statements are ingested (PS RBL worker, XAS multi-bank, monolith legacy) and matched to payout/reversal source events by UTR→GRN→CMS + balance/account + amount; matches flow back as payout_update (transaction_id / reversal) and, for Direct accounts, DA ledger journals; ART supplies human-gated repair via FTS attempt actions and BAS batch linking.
families.label: Bank statements, UTR matching, repair (XAS / PS BAS / ART)

families.description: payout_usage_event_processing worker emits usage and payout-property events (kafka_event_via_ps) for downstream analytics, gated by forPayoutPropertiesEventEvaluate.
families.label: Payout usage / property events

families.description: HandleIfVaToVaPayout routes virtual-account-sourced payouts onto va_to_va ledger events; fund_account_payout_sub_balance processor serves sub-balances (assume_sub_account); MakeCreditTransferCreateRequest + PATCH /v1/payouts/update_credit_transfer_payout close the credit-transfer leg; x_balance_payouts_event consumes x-balances payout events.
families.label: VA-source / sub-balance and credit-transfer payouts

families.description: vendor-payments creates payouts on the monolith (/v1/payouts_internal/, /v1/payouts/2fa/create_internal) with X-Dashboard-User-Id + X-Payout-Idempotency, receives status through twirp PayoutStatusChange under a Redis lock (duplicate pushes rejected), and the resulting payout status is republished on the Kafka prod.x.vendor-payments.accounting-payouts.status-update topic that accounting-integrations consumes.
families.label: Vendor payments and tax payments

families.description: Payouts from a shared/Lite VA or a sub_balance draw on a ledger MerchantBalance account discovered by banking_account_id; x-balances overwrites its stored number from ledger for shared/sub_balance rows. The payouts service posts va_to_va_payout_initiated and va_to_va_payout_failed (there is deliberately NO va_to_va_payout_reversed config -- failed and reversed both map to _failed), and the receiving/limit-allocation side va_to_va_credit_processed is posted by X-BALANCES from its sub_balance_limits service, not by the monolith. IMPORTANT SCOPE CORRECTION: the razorpay/virtual-account repo is inbound-collections only -- it initiates no payouts, performs no VA-to-VA transfer and writes no journal; it only resolves a banking-VA balance_id through x-balances ListAccounts and tracks money received in its own DynamoDB credits table. Nothing here runs in the twin.
families.label: Virtual-account (Lite VA / sub-balance / VA-to-VA) sourced payouts

families.description: Every payout state change that a merchant learns about asynchronously: payouts builds a ProcessEventPayload, calls Stork WebhookAPI/ProcessEvent, and Stork fans out one HMAC-signed POST per matching Subscription. At-least-once, no ordering guarantee, no dedupe: the merchant must dedupe on X-Razorpay-Event-Id.
families.label: Merchant webhook delivery (payout.* via Stork)
